source: Bavli Bava Metzia 87a; Bereshit Rabbah 48; the Masorah (via Minchat Shai on 18:9)
claim_en: THE SECOND DOTTED PLACE — AND A DOT-COUNT COLLATION: ויאמרו אליו ('and they said TO HIM: where is Sarah?') — the Talmud expounds the dots on aleph-yod-vav of אליו ('they also asked WHERE IS HE'). SNAPSHOT carries the dots IN THE STREAM — and dots ALL FOUR letters, the lamed included: the layer proven readable last block now yields its first collation delta (the tradition's three dotted letters against the codex's four). Filed with the count explicit.

source: Bereshit Rabbah 49; Shemot Rabbah 41; Midrash Tanchuma; Shocher Tov 18; the Masorah; Rashi (via Minchat Shai on 18:22)
claim_en: A TIKKUN SOFERIM (scribal emendation) — one of the EIGHTEEN: 'and Abraham STILL STOOD before YHWH' (18:22) — 'it should have said: and YHWH still stood before Abraham, but the text euphemized' (the tradition's own words). SNAPSHOT verifies the AS-WRITTEN order (Abraham standing) — the machine's plea-scene grammar — while the chain names the standing REVERSED by the scribes: a new tradition-class enters the audit (the emendations list), letter-verified on its Torah member.

source: Masekhet Soferim 4; Bavli Shevuot 35b (with the dissent of R. Chananiah and R. Eleazar HaModai) — via Minchat Shai on 18:3
claim_en: THE ONE PROFANE NAME OF ABRAHAM — 'all the Names said of Abraham are HOLY except one: ויאמר אדני אם נא (18:3, addressed to the guests)' — with the recorded dissent (even this is holy). SNAPSHOT: the nun in QAMATZ (the divine-form pointing) exactly as Minchat Shai rules — the pointed text carries the sacred shape while the classification dispute rides above it: the holy/profane Name layer's THIRD station (after 5:1's קדש and 6:2's חול), still classification-uninstrumented.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 18:5 (the itur soferim list — 'the scribes' adornment')
claim_en: AN ITUR SOFERIM — the second scribal-list class in one chapter: וסעדו לבכם אחר תעברו ('sustain your hearts; AFTER, pass on') — the sages' adornment-list: the connecting vav was REMOVED (achar, not ve-achar). SNAPSHOT: the bare אחר stands — the adorned reading letter-exact.

ואברהם ('and Abraham') VERSE-INITIAL — exactly FIVE in the Torah, the Kitzur's own list: old (18:11), shall-surely-become (18:18), old-advanced (24:1), ninety-nine (17:24), a hundred (21:5): 'though Abraham and Sarah were old — Abraham SHALL SURELY BECOME a great nation.' SNAPSHOT: the five exactly.

THE RIGHTEOUS OF SODOM WITHOUT THEIR YOD, row 1: צדיקם ('righteous ones') defective in the plea (18:24, 18:26) — the Kitzur: four defective in the passage, 'against Sodom's four judges, elders of shame'; the Torah's only PLENE righteous-plural is 'the eyes of the seeing' (Exod 23:8) — Deuteronomy's two law-tokens run defective likewise.

THE RIGHTEOUS OF SODOM WITHOUT THEIR YOD, row 2: the definite הצדיקם ('the righteous') — both Torah tokens inside the plea (18:24, 18:28), both defective: with row 1, the passage's FOUR lean righteous-words exactly as the Kitzur counts.

עפר ואפר ('DUST AND ASHES' — Abraham's self-word in the plea) — the pair once in the Torah; the Masorah's twin is Job's last word ('I repent upon dust and ashes,' Job 42:6; edge): 'greater what was said of Job than of Abraham' (Kitzur). From it the tradition hangs the heifer's ash and the accusation's dust (named).

THE TORAH IN THE FINALS: אשר יצוה את בניו ('that he will COMMAND his children') — the four words' final letters are the four letters of תורה ('Torah'; the ordered string רהתו verified, the anagram named): the command-verse carries its content in its endings.

THE ESCORT-MEASURE IN THE FINALS: על פני סדום ('over the face of Sodom') — the finals spell the letters of מיל ('mil,' the escort-distance; ordered לים verified, the anagram named): 'a mil he walked with them to send them off — the escort's measure.' And סדם itself is defective in the verse.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 18:13 (precise manuscripts; the Meiri; the Ramah)
claim_en: אמנם ('INDEED shall I bear?') — the aleph with 'three dots' (qubutz, the three-dot u-vowel) in all precise manuscripts, and the word defective (no vav) per the Ramah's rule for all its kin. SNAPSHOT: qubutz and lean, both exact.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 18:10 (precise books; the Ramah — against an old tikkun and a Mikra Gedolah note)
claim_en: שוב אשוב ('I will SURELY RETURN to you' — the annunciation): an old tikkun claims both defective; the precise books and the Ramah rule both PLENE. SNAPSHOT: both vavs stand — the return-promise written full, twice.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 18:21 (the Masorah's three)
claim_en: הבאה ('that has COME to Me' — the cry of Sodom): read MIL'EL (stress retracted) — one of the Masorah's THREE so read; SNAPSHOT: the accent on the first syllable exactly. The cry has already arrived — the stress pulled back with it.
האף ('will You INDEED sweep away?') — the he in PATACH in the precise manuscripts, and its neighbor likewise. SNAPSHOT: patach — the plea's opening particle pointed as ruled.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 18:8 (some manuscript books)
claim_en: והוא־עמד עליהם ('and HE stood over them, under the tree' — the host serving): joined by maqqef in some manuscript books; SNAPSHOT joins — the standing bound to the stander.

כחם ('in the HEAT of the day' — the sitting at the tent door): ONE Torah token; the Masorah's four run to the harvest-heat (Isa 18:4), the clear heat upon light, and Ish-Boshet's noon (II Sam 4:5) — edges; the Kitzur's gehinnom-door reading rides named-only.
ויקמו ('and they ROSE from there') — 'the inverted horn (mahpakh, the turning accent) on the qof.' SNAPSHOT: the turning stroke exactly where ruled — the visit turns toward Sodom on it.
